نرتشي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَشِي (nartašī) /nar.ta.ʃiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# نَرْتَشِيَ (nartašiya) /nar.ta.ʃi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
